account_frame.description: TODO: verify follower/date partition configuration and discovery coverage against collector evidence

author_decisions.restricted_profile_addon: pending; default artifact excludes profile text and social-link URLs

classification_ledger.basis: Source sidecar overrides or revision-pinned code inference, persisted before private fields are removed

collector_semantics.classification_basis: Code-inferred fetch outcome, not independent certification of current stored row-set completeness
collector_semantics.empty_refresh_caveat: update_user_repositories deletes obsolete rows only for a nonempty fetched list; a successful empty refresh can retain old rows
collector_semantics.execution_history_caveat: Provider identifies this collector; exact commands and logs still need confirmation

release_scope: All selected account records and their stored repository rows; profile text and user_links excluded
retrieval_policy: Use persisted users.retrieval_status and profile_available from the source classification ledger

sampling.caveat: Account sampling, not repository sampling. Portfolio-size heavy tails can make size extrapolation unstable

timestamp_semantics.repositories.created_at: GitHub repository createdAt retained on insertion, not fetch time (github_parser.py:30-34; database.py:94-105)
timestamp_semantics.user_links.created_at: Link-row timestamp; collector write path must be cited, not repository observation time
timestamp_semantics.users.created_at: Discovery insertion datetime.now(), not GitHub registration (popular_users.py:168-176)
timestamp_semantics.users.last_updated: Overloaded: user refresh/profile-enrichment time or failure sentinel, with parse_all reset; not repository observation time (database.py:41-67,243-252; fetch_user_profile.py:115-145; main.py:89-99)
timestamp_semantics.users.links_parsed_at: Link parsing stage timestamp; not repository observation time (database.py link parsing writers)
